verses.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

xrefs.text: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; His word was on my tongue.
My words are from an upright heart, and my lips speak sincerely what I know.
The heart of the wise man instructs his mouth and adds persuasiveness to his lips.
For I am full of words, and my spirit within me compels me.

verses.text: You are the most handsome of men; grace has anointed your lips; therefore God has blessed you forever.

xrefs.text: All spoke well of Him and marveled at the gracious words that came from His lips. “Isn’t this the son of Joseph? they asked.
My beloved is dazzling and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.
For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
“Never has anyone spoken like this man! the officers answered.
Such a high priest truly befits us— One who is holy, innocent, undefiled, set apart from sinners, and exalted above the heavens.

verses.text: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.

xrefs.text: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it pierces even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow. It judges the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
He made My mouth like a sharp sword; He hid Me in the shadow of His hand. He made Me like a polished arrow; He hid Me in His quiver.
He held in His right hand seven stars, and a sharp double-edged sword came from His mouth. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.
And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.

verses.text: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.

xrefs.text: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.
So I looked and saw a white horse, and its rider held a bow. And he was given a crown, and he rode out to overcome and conquer.
He put on righteousness like a breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on His head; He put on garments of vengeance and wrapped Himself in a cloak of zeal.
Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

verses.text: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.

xrefs.text: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox, to devour hostile nations and crush their bones, to pierce them with arrows.
For I will bend Judah as My bow and fit it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, O Zion, against the sons of Greece. I will make you like the sword of a mighty man.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.

verses.text: Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.

xrefs.text: But about the Son He says: “Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given, and the government will be upon His shoulders. And He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
In those days and at that time I will cause to sprout for David a righteous Branch, and He will administer justice and righteousness in the land.

verses.text: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy.

The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of His loving devotion.
And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.

verses.text: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.

xrefs.text: The fragrance of your perfume is pleasing; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the maidens adore you.
But thanks be to God, who always leads us triumphantly as captives in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of Him.
Nicodemus, who had previously come to Jesus at night, also brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
Before the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will make my way to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.

xrefs.text: My beloved calls to me, “Arise, my darling. Come away with me, my beautiful one.
Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
Anyone who loves his father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me;
And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for the sake of My name will receive a hundredfold and will inherit eternal life.
“Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”

xrefs.text: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
For your husband is your Maker— the LORD of Hosts is His name— the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; He is called the God of all the earth.
How beautiful you are, my darling— how very beautiful! Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats streaming down Mount Gilead.
The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

verses.text: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

xrefs.text: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him— even those unable to preserve their lives.
Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.
And at the end of seventy years, the LORD will restore Tyre. Then she will return to hire as a prostitute and sell herself to all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.
May the kings of Tarshish and distant shores bring tribute; may the kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts.

xrefs.text: You who dwell in the gardens, my companions are listening for your voice. Let me hear it!
I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you to one husband, to present you as a pure virgin to Christ.
Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Which way has he turned? We will seek him with you.
The fragrance of your perfume is pleasing; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the maidens adore you.
You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.

verses.text: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

So the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee.
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.

verses.text: Your sons will succeed your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

xrefs.text: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign upon the earth.

verses.text: I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.

xrefs.text: For My name will be great among the nations, from where the sun rises to where it sets. In every place, incense and pure offerings will be presented in My name, because My name will be great among the nations,” says the LORD of Hosts.
You will be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, a royal diadem in the palm of your God.
May his name endure forever; may his name continue as long as the sun shines. In him may all nations be blessed; may they call him blessed.
Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed.

“As for Me, this is My covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit will not depart from you, and My words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth or from the mouths of your children and grandchildren, from now on and forevermore,” says the LORD.
